recommendation_exact_scoring.scope: Small diagnostic sample with positive controls; group rates are not population estimates.

inference_boundaries: All SID routes are structurally reachable; this does not imply high generation probability.
Metadata-task exposure is not proof that metadata-to-SID identification has been learned.
Exact-scoring samples contain controls and must not be treated as population HR estimates.
BF16 rankings near ties need extra numerical care; accepted and single-history beam order may differ.
Raw-versus-reconstructed retrieval measures surviving content signal, not a trained hybrid result.
Novel semantic prefixes and poor scores are descriptive mechanism evidence, not a controlled training ablation.
These diagnostics do not distinguish insufficient auxiliary weight from forgetting without additional training-stage measurements.

protocol.prompt: Exact original SidItemFeatDataset.pre title2sid prompt; no target SID or behavioral label in input.
protocol.scoring: Full-vocabulary log-softmax, sum over full SID+newline+EOS; all 16572 candidates scored.
protocol.cache: Per-prompt prefill; candidate suffix batching; gold score independently checked without cache.
protocol.scope: 16 diagnostic items; not a population accuracy estimate; sampling independent of beam success.

protocol.query: Case/whitespace-normalized generated title is matched to all catalog items with that title. Mean their L2-normalized original saved vectors, then L2-normalize the mean.
protocol.ranking: Full 16572-item catalog cosine similarity, ties by ascending item ID; no seen-item filtering.
protocol.comparison: Exactly the same histories, separately queried by normalized mean of their normalized original item vectors.
protocol.scope: Post-hoc 64 cold + 64 warm diagnostic; content retrieval through generated catalog title is a separate probe, not the SFT SID output metric.
